text: In the internal logic of a topos, the formula ∀x:A. φ(x) is interpreted as:
choices: The set of all x:A satisfying φ
The intersection of all subobjects φ(a) for a:A
The image of the generic predicate
The universal quantification morphism (right adjoint to pullback along A→1)
explanation: ∀ is right adjoint to pullback: ∀_{A→1}: Sub(A) → Sub(1).
